reasoning: 14.1.7.1（BT1.7.1）規定目前選取的分類在 Categories Bank 中被標示。驗證標的是「標示跟著選取移動」，因此步驟選取兩個不同分類並比對標示位置，只讀一次無法區分是標示還是固定樣式。spec 未規定標示的視覺形式（與 BT1.3 的 outline、BT1.6 的 activated color 皆不同條），故 ER 只陳述「被標示為選取中」，不臆測樣式。優先級：屬顯示標記細節，訂 P2。

tcs.test_item:
The system shall highlight the currently selected category in the Categories Bank.

(Selection moved between two categories)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A USB drive containing at least ten files with a valid audio format is connected to the HU
2. USB is the active source on the HU
3. The Categories Bank for USB contains at least two categories
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Browse" on the Tab Buttons to open the Browse Tab
3. Press the first category in the Categories Bank and read which category is shown as selected
4. Press a different category in the Categories Bank and read which category is shown as selected
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and USB is the active source
2. The Browse Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The first category is shown as selected in the Categories Bank
4. The category pressed in step 4 is shown as selected and the category read in step 3 is no longer shown as selected
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
